properties.name: Beach Road & Second Road Circular Loop
properties.name_th: สายรอบเมือง ถนนเลียบชายหาด - สายสอง
properties.direction: Clockwise Loop (Beach Rd Southbound ➔ Second Rd Northbound)
properties.description: The standard 10-THB Songthaew loop. Runs south on Beach Road from Dolphin Roundabout to Walking Street, cuts east along South Pattaya Road, and runs north up Pattaya Second Road back to Terminal 21.

properties.name: South Pattaya to Jomtien Beach Line
properties.name_th: สายพัทยาใต้ - ชายหาดจอมเทียน
properties.direction: Bi-directional: Wat Chai Mongkhon ⇄ South Jomtien Beach
properties.description: Standard 10-THB route connecting Central/South Pattaya with Jomtien Beach. Boards outside Wat Chai Mongkhon school on South Pattaya Road, heads down Thappraya Road, and runs the entire length of Jomtien Beach Road.

properties.name: Dolphin Roundabout to Naklua Fish Market
properties.name_th: สายวงเวียนปลาโลมา - ตลาดลานโพธิ์นาเกลือ
properties.direction: Bi-directional: Dolphin Roundabout ⇄ Lan Pho Naklua Market
properties.description: Northern 10-THB commuter route linking the North Pattaya hotel district and Terminal 21 with historic Naklua Old Town and Lan Pho fresh seafood pier.
